checks: Default organization is server-confirmed before explicit scoped private usage
Same-tab actual organization selection automatically refreshes actual sidebar to selected organization
Only matching actor and organization creation notification refreshes usage
Organization transition aborts pending membership lookup and ignores late old membership
Late previous-organization usage response never overwrites current display
No confirmed organization suppresses private usage instead of requesting implicit default
Duplicate/malformed membership response cannot authorize usage request
Server organization that mismatches explicit selection cannot authorize usage
Authentication loading ABA discards old membership and preserves only fresh confirmation
Actor transition cancels old confirmation and rejects its late reply
Cross-tab storage event verifies and displays newly selected organization
Focus retries failed membership read and restores only current confirmed organization usage
scope: Actual full QuoteSidebar, actual organization helper/hook/parser, common usage panel and bounded transports mounted under React StrictMode. Synthetic auth and API only; no real customer usage, DB, paid provider or billing.
